craft_notes: Sthāyin: devouring — wonder peak. Rows: count, thin, devour, shine. Read aloud: thinning to blaze.

lines: There in the ever-risen, by breath-count alone is rise-count told;
double it, halve it, and so by rank; in the eight-plus-hundred wheel two hundred rise.
So by rank, in gross and fine, in the rested one's road-form —
breath thinned, time devoured come true —
whole, one, just this knowing, wonder-mighty, shines.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tatra sadodite prāṇacārasaṃkhyayaiva udayasaṃkhyā vyākhyātā taddviguṇite tadardham ityādi krameṇa aṣṭottaraśate cakre dviśata udayaḥ iti krameṇa sthūlasūkṣme cārasvarūpe viśrāntasya prāṇacāre kṣīṇe kālagrāse vṛtte sampūrṇām ekam evedaṃ saṃvedanaṃ citraśaktinirbharaṃ bhāsate
